Rock Winter at the Bastei

The viewpoints at the Bastei and the Bastei Bridge itself are deserted, the first rays of sunlight play around the rocks, the mist billows mystically in the Elbe valley and nature sings its song quietly.
Those who visit the Bastei in the summer months experience this in the morning and evening hours. A real insider tip is the winter season. Here it exists: the other side of the Bastei. In terms of peace and tranquility, this time cannot be beaten. Nature = recharging batteries - there is no faster way to slow down. 

The Berghotel & Panoramarestaurant Bastei offers its guests a "hot and cold" stay: relaxed walks in the heart of the Saxon Switzerland National Park, panoramic sauna & steam bath as well as a bath in the cedar wood tub of the wellness area with a concluding pampering menu in the world-famous panoramic restaurant. The Berghotel on the Bastei is the perfect place in the cold season to recharge your batteries and escape the stress of everyday life for a few days. Enjoy the other side of the Bastei for yourself!

Winter experiences at the Bastei

  • enjoy the breathtaking view from the Bastei Bridge

  • marvel at the enchanted Schwedenlöcher during a winter hike

  • test the culinary calendar of the Panorama Restaurant

  • experience a sunrise at the Bastei

  • recharge your batteries in the comforting warmth of the panorama sauna at the Berghotel Bastei
